title: Enforce print template authority independently of request path
description:
Stage 3 verified authority-path repair, direct follow-up to ERP-450 (same defect class as ERP-462 / ERP-463 / ERP-464 / ERP-465 / ERP-466 / ERP-467 / ERP-468 / ERP-487 and the menu repair above). src/ERP.Api/Controllers/PrintTemplateController.cs:62-67 still waives live authorization by request shape: private bool RequiresLiveAuthorization() { var http = ControllerContext?.HttpContext; if (http is null) return false; return http.Request.Path.HasValue || CurrentUserId() is not null; }, and EnsureAuthorizedAsync:70-74 calls PrintTemplateAuthorizationRules.EnsureAuthorizedAsync(_db, CurrentUserId()) only when that probe is true. An identity-less or account-status-less context that is not bound to the request pipeline, or that carries an empty Request.Path, therefore reads the print template ledger (GetList:77-88, GetDefault:90-100) and saves, deletes, exports and imports template rows (Save:103-198, Delete:199-211, ExportExcel:212-225, ImportExcel:226-...) without live identity, ERP-453 account status or the existing 「样式设计」(print-design) menu authority, so a denied account can mint a default template, silently change抬頭 / 纸张 / 字号 / 字段顺序 / 颜色 for any bill type, or read and re-import template workbooks. Remove the request-shape helper and the if (RequiresLiveAuthorization()) wrapper and make the existing live identity / account-status / print-design menu authority unconditional on every route, preserving PrintTemplateAuthorizationRules.NormalizeForWrite, ValidateForSave bounded layout/paper/font/color/field-order validation, IsPrintableBillType, the existing default-template switch semantics and the existing delete behaviour. Adapt the legacy in-process print-template fixtures to genuine enabled identities holding their existing print-design menu grants in isolated test data only. No Request.Path, environment, blank-context or test-only switch, no anonymous or administrative fallback, no permission/menu/grant expansion, no production access, no schema change. Genuine SQL uses exactly (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database, refusing existing or wrong targets before access and never dropping or resetting. Safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors plus the full unit suite is required; a build alone is not whole-stage acceptance.
2026-10-13 scope repair: The first run correctly adapted TradeDocumentPrintTests real print-template-controller fixture to enabled identity/existing print-design grants, but path guard rejected the omitted allowed file. That exact existing regression file is now authorized. Adapt it only with genuine existing test grants; retain all original trade-document output/business assertions. Do not waive authorization or replace checks to accommodate anonymous fixtures. Preserve complete original attempt1/pathguard diff. All generated test output/TRX must use explicit .ai/logs/ERP-493 directories, no root TestResults files. Do not reset attempts or increase max_attempts.
acceptance_criteria: Every route on /api/sys/print-templates (list, default template, save, delete, Excel export and Excel import) requires the current live enabled nondeleted identity and the existing 样式设计 (print-design) functional menu before any SysPrintTemplates row is read, generated or written, independent of whether Request.Path is set, whether HttpContext is bound and how the request is shaped; RequiresLiveAuthorization and the if (RequiresLiveAuthorization()) wrapper are removed, missing/zero/unknown/deleted identity fails Unauthorized and disabled/revoked/missing-menu identity fails Forbidden, and no anonymous, administrative, environment or test-only fallback is added.

Retain the permitted print-design lifecycle and the existing bounded validation: PrintTemplateAuthorizationRules.NormalizeForWrite, ValidateForSave persisted-column / supported bill-type / paper / font-size / color / field-order checks, IsPrintableBillType, the built-in default fallback for unknown or absent templates, the same-type single-default switch semantics and the existing delete behaviour; denied reads return no template row or byte and denied save/delete/import persists zero SysPrintTemplates mutation, with no new menu, grant, permission, table or column.

Adapt the legacy in-process print-template fixtures to genuine enabled identities holding their existing print-design grants in isolated test data only, and add genuine isolated SQL controller tests covering list, default, save, delete, export and import with no HttpContext, empty and populated Request.Path, missing/zero/deleted identity, disabled and revoked-menu identity, invalid layout payloads and permitted flows; existing PrintTemplateTests and PrintTemplateAuthorizationTests contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build with analyzers and warnings-as-errors and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, run genuine SQL only on the isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance instance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database that is never dropped or reset, and claim no whole-stage acceptance from a build alone.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/PrintTemplateController.cs:62-67 RequiresLiveAuthorization() returns false whenever ControllerContext?.HttpContext is null and otherwise returns http.Request.Path.HasValue || CurrentUserId() is not null; EnsureAuthorizedAsync:70-74 executes PrintTemplateAuthorizationRules.EnsureAuthorizedAsync (_db, CurrentUserId()) only inside if (RequiresLiveAuthorization()), and it is the only authority for GetList:77-88, GetDefault:90-100, Save:103-198, Delete:199-211, ExportExcel:212-225 and ImportExcel:226 onward (rule menu code print-design at src/ERP.Application/Services/PrintTemplateAuthorizationRules.cs:37, EnsureAuthorizedAsync:218-235, ValidateForSave:285). src/ERP.UnitTests/PrintTemplateAuthorizationTests.cs:28,324 also drives the in-process Request.Path-shape expectation that must be adapted, and no existing task removes this waiver (exact search of .ai/tasks returns ERP-450 only, which introduced it).
